d:
The Much Awaited Romantic Chart buster 'Tere Bina' is Shorgul' Film's First Song.
The Song pulls together for the first time a power packed Combination that marks the Debut of Sitar/ Zitar Maestro Niladri Kumar as a Music Director. Kapil Sibal has penned the Lyrics and the Soulful inimitable Arijit Singh will be heard in a unique style with this song, that will leave everyone singing along with an unforgettable tune that will remain etched in their hearts.
